about: ONE clip, ONE shot, nothing cut inside: green polo, triple-dipper par 4 — perfect lie by the green: “This one should be a little bit easier, don't you think? … Just nice and easy.” → the chip goes straight up (tracer) and drops about a foot in front of you → “Well, I can putt that, so I'm good with that.” Your talk is the punchline so it stays; your original sound and captions. Line “me when it's literally an easy chip” in the upper band (Oct 17 spec: Inter Bold 46, outline + shadow) — your head stays well below it the whole clip. From Video Oct 12 2026, 12 17 30 AM.mov (113.30–126.60 s, your whole clip), which you posted yourself on @mackygolfs Oct 14 — “You me par four? 👉👈” https://www.instagram.com/reel/DefODPLhS7S/ (170 s of it in that post, fingerprint checked). Not in any shorty or compilation (only its 0.4 s contact sound is in the asmr comp). Heads up: it's the shot right after the bunker shorty (“me in the bunker after a couple drinks”), so don't post them back to back. True original, single crf-17 export; preview copy here. Alt caption: “the green was right there”.
